B_entity_vs_bridge.model: Qwen3-1.7B-Base bf16; carrier L20 KV6 at r0; recipients = the 64 entry-1 recipients
B_entity_vs_bridge.EB1_weight_edit: one single-request MEMIT patch per recipient (mdb_lanes.memit, EasyEdit Qwen2.5 defaults: layers 4-8, 25 z steps; C0 from >= 200k wikitext-103 tokens) rewriting hop 1 (attribute prompt per family: currency 'The {X} is the currency of', person '{X} was born in the country of', landmark '{X} is located in the country of', city '{X} is a city in the country of') to the first donor's country. The descriptor tokens are untouched. With the patch installed: hop-1 efficacy (attribute prompt and a paraphrase), the two-hop answer (new capital / old / other), the carrier readout (attention-weighted L20 KV6 write at r0, best of the panel's country tokens: new / old / other), and two site tests: (i) plant the patched run's L20 KV6 r0 value cell into the unpatched model; (ii) restore the native cell under the patch. Locality: two-hop argmax of 8 other recipients under each patch.
B_entity_vs_bridge.EB2_same_country_diff_entity: city-family recipients with a same-country different-city donor (any length; V of the donor's last descriptor row copied into r0 at L20 KV6, single cell, and the V band L8-27 at r0). Scoring frozen: recipient capital kept / donor city copied (argmax is the first token of the donor's city) / other.
B_entity_vs_bridge.EB3_non_answer_entity_donors: already measured in entry 1: currency/person/landmark donors whose entity cannot be an answer; their flip-to-donor-capital rate is reported beside city-family donors (no new run).
B_entity_vs_bridge.decision_rule: bridge reading supported if, among edits with hop-1 efficacy, the carrier readout names the new country on >= 0.5 AND planting the edited cell in the unpatched model gives the new capital on >= 0.3. Entity-only (subject enrichment) reading supported if planting gives the new capital on <= 0.1 and the readout names the old country on >= 0.5. Anything else: mixed, reported with numbers.
